activation_gate: fresh independent review of exact v7 fingerprint
future-triggered scheduled runtime acceptance and synchronized email if integrated

invariants.exact_fetch_prompt: Extract only source text relevant to the frozen research question. Preserve document title, publication or filing date, section or page locator, and exact quotations. Do not infer or summarize unsupported facts.

lifecycle.rule: provider and exact logical request validate before capacity mutation
counter, canonical receipt bytes, reservation id, and digest publish atomically under one RLock
report is untrusted; candidate performs no provider or network call
complete operation-specific shape and every present origin URL validate before bounds; every terminal path consumes once and stores a Draft-valid receipt

report_validation_before_bounds.malformed: consume exactly once, store schema-valid UNKNOWN with MALFORMED_SETTLEMENT_CONSUMED_UNKNOWN_NO_REPLAY, then raise stable PolicyError
precedence: canonical final_url and every redirect member
report_validation_before_bounds.web_fetch_FAIL: captured result must be empty and origin fields absent
report_validation_before_bounds.web_fetch_PASS_OR_UNKNOWN: pair must be both absent or both correctly typed and every URL canonical
report_validation_before_bounds.web_search: final_url and redirect_chain forbidden for every outcome and canonically checked first if present

url_admission.postparse: Exact raw reconstruction must equal input; parser normalization never grants admission.
url_admission.runtime_assertion: Identical explicit code-point ranges are rejected before urlsplit.
url_admission.schema_assertion: Unanchored not/pattern excludes U+0000-U+0020, U+007F-U+00A0, U+1680, U+2000-U+200A, U+2028-U+2029, U+202F, U+205F, and U+3000 anywhere; no end anchor dependency.
